hypotheses.B1_every_individual_semantic_path_is_low: Every semantic edit context has output-space rank-to-90%-energy at most 16.

hypotheses.B3_a_balanced_global_semantic_subspace_i: At most 64 directions explain 90% of the equally weighted 38-path semantic panel.
hypotheses.B4_family_rank32_is_robust_per_context: Each family's rank-32 basis reconstructs at least 75% of every member context's trajectory energy.
hypotheses.B5_leave_one_pair_out_family_transfer_is: A rank-32 family basis excluding the target lexical pair reconstructs at least 50% of every held-out pair's trajectory energy.
hypotheses.B6_family_bases_beat_the_global_basis_at: At rank 32, mean family-basis reconstruction exceeds the balanced global basis by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.B7_same_family_path_subspaces_are_more_a: Mean rank-8 path-subspace alignment is at least 0.05 higher within semantic families than between families.
hypotheses.B8_unbalanced_global_rank_hides_low_ener: The unbalanced rank-32 global basis has worst-context fidelity at least 0.10 below the balanced rank-32 basis.
hypotheses.B9_balanced_global_rank64_is_robust_per_: The balanced global rank-64 basis reconstructs at least 75% of every context's trajectory energy.
hypotheses.B10_finite_mlp_changes_are_captured_by_f: Each family's rank-32 basis reconstructs at least 90% of every member's finite MLP change squared norm.
